column1: # TITLE: Identification of novel candidate target genes at 3q26.2-q29 in squamous cell carcinoma of the lung
# SUMMARY: High-resolution array-CGH was performed to identify differences in the patterns of genomic imbalances between SCC and AC of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). On a genome-wide profile
column2: SCCs showed higher frequency of gains than ACs (p = 0.067). More specifically
column3: statistically significant differences were observed across the histologic subtypes for gains at 2q14.2
column10: and gains at 7q22.1 and losses at 15q22.2-q25.2 occurred in AC (P < 0.05). The most striking difference between SCC and AC was gains at 3q26.2-q29
